title: SoK: Attack and Defense Landscape of Agentic AI Systems
authors: Juhee Kim; Wenbo Guo; Dawn Song
mas_security_scope: Component-centered agentic AI security SoK with partial multi-agent coverage; not MAS-first.
why_strongly_related: Closest accepted SoK in venue and method. It motivates why the new work must move from agent components to interaction structure and global properties.
evidence_basis: Official USENIX page and prepublication full text

title: Open Challenges in Multi-Agent Security: Towards Secure Systems of Interacting AI Agents
authors: Christian Schroeder de Witt et al.
mas_security_scope: Defines multi-agent security around threats that emerge or amplify through interaction.
why_strongly_related: Directly claims the field boundary, discusses collusion, propagation, observability, containment, attribution, and systemic risk.
evidence_basis: Primary preprint full text; author list abbreviated because the paper has a large consortium

title: Seven Security Challenges in Cross-Domain Multi-Agent LLM Systems
authors: Ronny Ko; Jiseong Chung; Shuyuan Zheng; Chuan Xiao; Tae-Wan Kim; Makoto Onizuka; Won-Yong Shin
mas_security_scope: Security agenda for heterogeneous LLM agents collaborating across organizational and trust domains.
why_strongly_related: Direct MAS security competitor covering seven challenges, plausible attacks, metrics, and research directions, but not a corpus-level SoK.

title: TRiSM for Agentic AI: A Review of Trust, Risk, and Security Management in LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Shaina Raza; Ranjan Sapkota; Manoj Karkee; Christos Emmanouilidis
mas_security_scope: Review of trust, risk, privacy, security, explainability, ModelOps, and lifecycle governance in agentic MAS.
why_strongly_related: MAS-primary review, but broader governance and trust management rather than an interaction-native security evidence audit.

title: Security Considerations for Multi-agent Systems
authors: Tam Nguyen; Moses Ndebugre; Dheeraj Arremsetty
mas_security_scope: Constructs a MAS threat inventory and scores 16 security and governance frameworks against 193 threat items.
why_strongly_related: Directly quantifies framework coverage for MAS, but its unit is framework coverage rather than academic attack, defense, and benchmark evidence.

title: SoK: Trust-Authorization Mismatch in LLM Agent Interactions
authors: Guanquan Shi; Haohua Du; Zhiqiang Wang; Xiaoyu Liang; Weiwenpei Liu; Song Bian; Zhenyu Guan
mas_security_scope: Unifies agent-interaction threats through belief, intention, permission, and trust-authorization mismatch.
why_strongly_related: Strong SoK-style comparator with a formal causal lens, but not a comprehensive MAS architecture, failure-property, and observability systematization.

title: A Survey on the Unique Security of Autonomous and Collaborative LLM Agents: Threats, Defenses, and Futures
authors: Yinggang Sun; Haining Yu; Wei Jiang; Xiangzhan Yu; Dongyang Zhan; Lixu Wang; Siyue Ren; Yue Sun; Tianqing Zhu
mas_security_scope: Covers external interaction, internal cognition, and multi-agent collaboration attacks.
why_strongly_related: Explicit collaboration-attack branch and benchmark comparison, but MAS is one branch within a broader agent-security survey.
evidence_basis: Official preprint page and full text

title: Systematization of Knowledge: Security and Safety in the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem
authors: Shiva Gaire; Srijan Gyawali; Saroj Mishra; Suman Niroula; Dilip Thakur; Umesh Yadav
mas_security_scope: MCP security and safety taxonomy with implications for distributed tool delegation and multi-agent environments.
why_strongly_related: Important protocol and infrastructure comparator, but MCP often connects one host agent to tools and is broader than strict multi-agent interaction.

title: SoK: The Attack Surface of Agentic AI -- Tools, and Autonomy
mas_security_scope: Agentic attack-surface SoK covering tools, RAG, autonomy, and some multi-agent emergent threats.
why_strongly_related: Useful systems-security comparator, but multi-agent interaction is not the primary analysis boundary.

title: A Systematic Survey of Security Threats and Defenses in LLM-Based AI Agents: A Layered Attack Surface Framework
mas_security_scope: Uses a seven-layer agentic attack-surface model with multi-agent coordination as one layer.
why_strongly_related: Auditable broad agent-security survey and coverage analysis, but not MAS-first.

title: Toward Secure LLM Agents: Threat Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation
authors: Yuchen Ling; Shengcheng Yu; Zhenyu Chen; Chunrong Fang
mas_security_scope: Lifecycle-based review of 247 LLM-agent security papers; multi-agent propagation is an emerging concern.
why_strongly_related: Closest broad auditable agent-security review, but its unit remains the general LLM agent lifecycle rather than MAS interaction structure.

title: A Survey on Trustworthy LLM Agents: Threats and Countermeasures
authors: Miao Yu; Fanci Meng; Xinyun Zhou; Shilong Wang; Junyuan Mao; Linsey Pang; Tianlong Chen; Kun Wang; Xinfeng Li; Yongfeng Zhang; Bo An; Qingsong Wen
mas_security_scope: Models peer agents as an extrinsic trust surface within a broader trustworthy-agent taxonomy.
why_strongly_related: Includes MAS attacks, defenses, and evaluation, but mixes security with broader trustworthiness dimensions.

title: AI Agents Under Threat: A Survey of Key Security Challenges and Future Pathways
authors: Zehang Deng; Yongjian Guo; Changzhou Han; Wanlun Ma; Junwu Xiong; Sheng Wen; Yang Xiang
mas_security_scope: Broad component-oriented LLM-agent security survey with partial communication and MAS coverage.
why_strongly_related: Important inherited-risk comparator for separating single-agent component attacks from interaction-dependent failures.
evidence_basis: ACM Digital Library publisher record and full text

title: The Emerged Security and Privacy of LLM Agent: A Survey with Case Studies
authors: Feng He; Tianqing Zhu; Dayong Ye; Bo Liu; Wanlei Zhou; Philip S. Yu
mas_security_scope: Broad LLM-agent security and privacy survey with agent-to-agent interaction among several system components.
why_strongly_related: Useful for inherited attack and defense coverage, but not organized around collective security invariants.
evidence_basis: ACM Digital Library publisher record and full text
